digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle policies and enforcement gates
propositions: Both material-pin and plan-review enforcement policies must be independently enableable in rebar.toml while remaining disabled by default in the reusable configuration schema
Legacy unpinned attestations and existing pins must continue to pass both enforcement gates without backfill or migration
Stale material-pin drift must reject claim or close with exit 1, preserve status, and report the canonical stale target and stale-pin-drift reason
Missing or phase-incompatible plan-review at close must reject transition with exit 1, preserve in_progress status, and instruct to run review-plan
Unchanged successful re-review must not propagate invalidation to downstream dependents
Enable/disable/re-enable cycles, transitive invalidation, depends_on plus blocks normalization, code-only drift, and concurrent changes must be proven through public lifecycle test surfaces
